test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

The painting was done by his son.

options.text: His son is doing the painting.
The painting was completed by his son.
The painting was his son work.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**His son did the painting**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Identify the subject (doer of the action), the verb, and the object (receiver of the action) in the passive sentence.
 
 
• **Subject**: his son</li
